Tupac Shakur murder trial begins in Las Vegas

Opening statements are scheduled to begin Monday in the Las Vegas trial of Duane "Keffe D" Davis, 63, who is accused of orchestrating the 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur. Davis is charged with murder with a deadly weapon. Prosecutors allege Davis participated in the shooting as an act of gang retaliation. The defense has pointed to a lack of hard evidence. The jury selection process has concluded, with testimony expected to last several weeks.
